description: Event-conditioned, market-adjusted (vs CHZ) token reaction profiles for football events — by event_type x event_side(for/against) x minute x scoreline_state x importance. Returns mean/median abnormal return, match-clustered t-stat, bootstrap 95% CI, hit rate, decay/persistence, n_events, n_matches, FDR. Omit a dimension to pool. Every cell carries its sample size — descriptive history, not advice.

event_side.description: 'for' = token's team scored / opponent sent off; 'against' = conceded / own red card.

scoreline_state.description: Token team's state BEFORE the event.

name: tokenintel_event_reaction_profile
